title: Americans and AI 2026: Chatbots, Smart Devices and Views on Impact
discussion_signal: The researcher relay emphasizes that non-users often cite privacy, distrust, lack of interest, or lack of confidence as reasons not to adopt chatbots, showing that ordinary availability does not eliminate perceived-control and legitimacy barriers.
linked_research_question: As AI becomes ordinary in daily life, which forms of distrust, privacy concern, and perceived lack of control continue to support non-use or selective use?
limits: Post focuses on non-users and does not represent all AI experiences
Reported reasons for non-use are descriptive rather than causal
